# --embed: the base joins the enclosing repository's history, and the init
# commit records exactly the base's own paths, leaving the host worktree's
# staged changes as they were.

env GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=2
env GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=user.name
env GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=ambient
env GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=user.email
env GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1=ambient@local

mkdir host
cd host
exec git init -q

# Unrelated host work, staged before the base is created.
cp ../host-wip.txt host.txt
exec git add host.txt
exec git diff --cached --name-only
stdout '^host\.txt$'

exec akb init docs --embed
stdout '^Initialized KB "docs" at .*/host/docs$'
stdout '^kb: docs is embedded inside repository .*; akb commits only kb/, raw/, \.agent-kb/$'
stdout '^commit identity: from git config \(ambient <ambient@local>\) — not recorded; each machine''s git identity applies$'

# No nested repository: the base is versioned by the host repository.
! exists docs/.git
exists docs/kb/index.md
exists docs/raw/files.log
exists docs/.agent-kb/akb.yaml
exists docs/.agent-kb/.gitignore
exists docs/.gitignore
grep '^name: docs$' docs/.agent-kb/akb.yaml
grep '^versioning: git$' docs/.agent-kb/akb.yaml

# The init commit records exactly the base's paths.
exec bash -c 'git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD | sort > "$WORK/init-commit-paths.txt"'
cmp ../init-commit-paths.txt ../init-commit-paths-expected.txt

# The host's staged work is untouched: still staged, still uncommitted.
exec git status --porcelain
stdout '^A  host\.txt$'
! stdout 'docs/'
! exec git config --local user.name
! exec git config --local user.email

cd docs
exec akb status
stdout '^Name: docs$'
# The hosting repository carries the host's staged work, so it is not clean:
# the status line reports the repository the base lives in.
stdout '^Git: dirty$'

-- host-wip.txt --
Unrelated host work, staged before the base is created.

-- init-commit-paths-expected.txt --
docs/.agent-kb/.gitignore
docs/.agent-kb/akb.yaml
docs/.gitignore
docs/kb/index.md
docs/kb/log.md
docs/raw/files.log
